annual_rate.notes: Tenn. Code Ann. § 47-14-123 permits a judge or jury to award prejudgment interest as an element of damages at a rate not exceeding 10% per year. The award and rate are discretionary; 10% is a ceiling, not an automatic default. Confirm the current statute and controlling case law. Not legal advice.
